name: Failure-Domain Mapping Workshop
description: Force every architectural option to declare its failure domains before it is chosen, by walking a catalogue of ten failure classes this estate has actually exhibited. Per applicable class the option must state the symptom, WHO NOTICES, the blast radius and a detection probe. If the answer to 'who notices' is nobody, or the domain has no probe, the option carries an unmonitored failure domain and must say so. Options are then compared on domains, not on features. An option with zero domains is a red flag, not a green light.

options.description: The architectural options to map; one mapper runs per option

failure_class_catalogue_path.description: The maintained catalogue of measured failure classes; catalogue completeness bounds this blueprint

require_probe_per_domain.description: When true, an applicable domain with no detection probe cannot be called handled

mapper.description: Walks the whole catalogue against exactly one option and declares each domain

comparator.description: Builds the cross-option table on DOMAINS, refusing to rank on features

stages.title: S0-S3 WALK the catalogue per option and name a probe per domain

work_unit.title: Map one option against every class in the failure catalogue
work_unit.question_or_target: For each of the ten measured failure classes, decide whether it applies to this option, and if so state symptom, who notices, blast radius and a detection probe.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: one mapper per option so the comparison table is built from independent walks

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every applicable domain names a concrete detection probe, or is explicitly marked unmonitored with who_notices=nobody
tests_required: an option carrying a try/except ImportError guard MUST flag fail-open-on-missing-dependency
an option whose who_notices is 'the agent' for a fail-open class must be rejected, since the agent is exactly what does not notice
an option mapping to zero domains must be flagged under-specified, never accepted as safe
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the comparator, which cross-checks that all ten classes were walked
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC04-S0 only when all ten catalogue classes appear in the artifact with an explicit applies true or false; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC04-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a re-framed option description

stages.title: S0 gate: the whole catalogue was walked, not a subset
S3b MARK which probes exist today and which must be built

work_unit.title: Split declared probes into exists-today and must-be-built
work_unit.question_or_target: For every named detection probe, establish whether it exists and runs today, or is a probe that would have to be built.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a domain whose probe does not exist yet is an unmonitored domain today

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each exists-today claim cites the file and the command that runs the probe
tests_required: a probe claimed to exist must be shown to FIRE on a known-broken state before the claim is accepted
a probe that cannot be located must be classified must-be-built, never assumed present
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the mapper of the affected option confirms the classification
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC04-S3B only when every exists-today probe cites a file and a command, and was shown to fire on a known-broken state; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC04-S3B <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to declaring the probe must-be-built

stages.title: S3 gate: every unmonitored domain is disclosed, not quietly omitted
S4 COMPARE options on DOMAINS, not on features

work_unit.title: Build the cross-option comparison table keyed on failure domains
work_unit.question_or_target: Rank the options by unmonitored-domain count and blast radius, explicitly refusing to rank on feature count.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the comparison is arithmetic over declared domains; only the tie-break is judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the table shows, per option, each applicable class and whether it is monitored today
tests_required: an option with the most features but the most unmonitored domains must not rank first
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner, who chooses among mapped options
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC04-S4 only when every option column lists all ten classes with a monitored-today flag; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC04-S4 <reason>

stages.title: S4 gate: an option with zero domains is under-specified, not safe

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the options; writes only under command-center/failure-domains/**

x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: a fixed, MEASURED ten-class catalogue is walked against each option, and the load-bearing output is 'who notices' plus a named probe per domain. BP-ARC-03 audits what already exists; this maps options before one is chosen.
x_extensions.honest_bound: catalogue completeness bounds this blueprint: it can only surface classes the catalogue contains. It maps; it does not prove. Proving a domain is handled is the testing family's job, not this one's.

worked_example.name: a try/except ImportError guard must flag fail-open
worked_example.narrative: An option is described by two traits: it guards an optional dependency with try/except ImportError, and it pins a ref. Both corresponding classes must come back applicable. A detection probe is supplied for the pinned ref but NOT for the fail-open guard, so fail-open-on-missing-dependency comes back unmonitored - and that is precisely the class that produced nine of nine disarmed checks at one measurement.

probes.stale-pinned-ref: re-resolve the ref and compare to the pin on every run

controls.why: the probe is what converts a declared domain into a monitored one
zero applicable domains must be reachable, or the walk is rubber-stamping
